points.text: THON HOLDING AS is registered as aksjeselskap (AS) based in Oslo, registered under 'Drift av hoteller', founded 1985-09-01.
What it does (per its website): Som Norges største private eiendomsaktør skaper Thon rom for muligheter – med boliger, næringseiendom, hotell og kjøpesentre. Se mulighetene dine her.
Latest filed accounts (2025): revenue 845.7M NOK, operating result -125.7M, net result 33.3M; revenue up 14% vs 2024 (calculated).
Leadership: Daglig leder: Kjetil Nilsen; Styrets leder: Kjetil Nilsen.
Verified website: https://thon.no/ (exact legal name plus registry phone/address on site).
Recent official register changes: 2026-10-14 registered employees; 2026-09-15 registered employees; 2026-08-13 registered employees.
